4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub repository live on GitHub Pages with a home page (single image + page menu) and at least one content page — first name only, no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can create a new page and link it in my home page menu so that my content is organized, not crowded onto my home page.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: Timed transition — post yesterday's time (2 min)
I do: model creating a new page + linking it in the menu (5 min)
You do: build one new content page — interests list, no age/location (15 min)
Link your new page in the menu; turn in your updated link on Google Classroom (5 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your new page's link (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday we built our home page. Today we build our first real content page and link it in, so your home page stays clean. Tomorrow we look at each other's pages and find things we have in common.
